IN ORDER FOR A VOTE TO BE ACCEPTED, THE VOTED POSITION MUST BE BLOCKED IN THE REQUIRED ESCROW ACCOUNT IN THE CREST SYSTEM. BY VOTING ON THIS MEETING, YOUR CREST SPONSORED MEMBER/CUSTODIAN MAY USE YOUR VOTE INSTRUCTION AS THE AUTHORIZATION TO TAKE THE NECESSARY ACTION WHICH WILL INCLUDE TRANSFERRING YOUR INSTRUCTED POSITION TO ESCROW. PLEASE CONTACT YOUR CREST SPONSORED MEMBER/CUSTODIAN DIRECTLY FOR FURTHER INFORMATION ON THE CUSTODY PROCESS AND WHETHER OR NOT THEY REQUIRE SEPARATE INSTRUCTIONS FROM YOU
